one_line: An African-descended naval commander of the Siddi-ruled island fort of Janjira on the Konkan coast, 16th–17th centuries CE.

appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, deep brown complexion, wide-set sharp eyes with thick brows, slightly broad nose, trimmed moustache and short beard framing the mouth, default expression focused and calm with a hint of proud resolve
appearance.hair: short, tightly curled black hair, neatly kept under a deep indigo cotton turban wrapped low around the head with one tail tucked at the back and a simple bronze charm pinned at the left temple
appearance.costume: a long, knee-length white cotton jama (Mughal-style wrap coat) crossing right over left and tied with inner strings, worn over a pale beige quilted sleeveless vest for light armor, the jama’s cuffs and neckline edged with narrow indigo trim; a wide dark red cotton patka (sash) wrapped twice around the waist with one short tail hanging on the left; loose straight-cut navy-blue cotton churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; sturdy brown leather sandals with simple straps; over the shoulders a lightweight sea-green woolen shawl folded narrow like a naval officer’s cloak and draped from the left shoulder across the back; small bronze hoop earrings in both ears and a plain bronze signet ring on the right hand, with a utilitarian leather belt crossing the torso diagonally to support the weapon scabbard
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Indo-Arabic talwar with a simple steel blade, dark brass hilt, and round disc pommel, carried sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging at his left hip, plus a subtle secondary prop of a rolled palm-leaf nautical chart tucked into his waist sash

ref_desc: Siddi Sea Captain of Janjira is a deep-brown-complexioned, short-curled-haired African-descended naval commander in an indigo turban, white jama over beige vest, dark red sash, navy trousers, sea-green shawl, carrying a curved talwar at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style African-descended Siddi naval commander from 16th–17th century Janjira: early 30s, athletic, deep brown complexion, oval face with sharp wide-set eyes, trimmed moustache and short beard, short tightly curled black hair under a deep indigo cotton turban wrapped low around the head with a small bronze charm at the left temple. He wears a knee-length white cotton jama crossing right over left, edged with narrow indigo trim at cuffs and neckline, over a pale beige quilted sleeveless vest, with a wide dark red cotton patka (sash) around his waist, one short tail hanging on the left. His trousers are loose, straight-cut navy-blue cotton gathered at the ankles, with sturdy brown leather sandals. A sea-green woolen shawl is folded narrow and draped from his left shoulder across his back like a modest naval cloak, and a diagonal leather belt supports his weapon scabbard. He has small bronze hoop earrings, a plain bronze ring on his right hand, and a rolled palm-leaf nautical chart tucked into his sash. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved Indo-Arabic talwar in a simple brown leather scabbard with dark brass hilt and disc pommel. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, white, dark red, navy blue, and sea green, and pose him in a steady, alert stance that conveys disciplined maritime leadership.
